quest.title: The Moonlit Adeptus's Trail
quest.description: You run into someone who loves listening to stories in Liyue Harbor...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Baofei
dialogues.text: ...Hehe, yesterday I heard another story about the White Horse Adeptus, and now I'm feeling inspired again.

response.speaker: Baofei
response.text: Eh? Ah! H—Hello, hello, hello! W—Welcome to Liyue Harbor! Welcome to the Lantern Rite... No, wait... Welcome to Liyue Harbor!

response.speaker: Baofei
response.text: Phew, Miss Pingxi didn't see that, right? Okay... looks like she didn't...

response.speaker: Baofei
response.text: Welcome to Liyue Harbor! You must be here for the Lantern Rite, right? Then you've gotta check out my mini-game, "The Moonlit Adeptus's Trail"...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You've switched straight into work mode, huh...

response.speaker: Baofei
response.text: D—Don't sell me out! If Miss Pingxi caught me distracted, she'd definitely give me an earful!

response.speaker: Baofei
response.text: It took me ages to talk her into letting me run this stall, just let me finish up...

response.speaker: Baofei
response.text: Ahem, ahem. "The Moonlit Adeptus's Trail" is based on the legend of the "White Horse Adeptus," a story shared throughout the Liyue Harbor.

response.speaker: Baofei
response.text: Legend has it that this adeptus would often travel through the skies by moonlight, protecting Liyue Harbor from evil spirits and monsters...

response.speaker: Baofei
response.text: ...Well, I found that legend so uninspired, so... hehe, I chose to blend in some other stories I've heard for this mini-game.

response.speaker: Baofei
response.text: For example, there have been monsters in the sky, who were always itching to swallow the whole moon! But thanks to the White Horse Adeptus, these monsters didn't get their way...

response.speaker: Baofei
response.text: I can't imagine what the moon would look like while being eaten... but in Liu Su's story, the monsters chew it down slowly, piece by piece — kind of like how we work through a pancake.

response.speaker: Baofei
response.text: But when I went to listen a couple of days later, his story was put in another way. This time, a monster gulped down the whole moon in one bite, just like eating a riceball.

response.speaker: Baofei
response.text: Fortunately, the story always ended with the White Horse Adeptus wiping out all the monsters in one fell swoop, guided by the light from the Xiao Lanterns.

response.speaker: Traveler
response.text: That's part of the legend too?

response.speaker: Baofei
response.text: Anyway, that's how Liu Su's story goes. I thought it was cool, so I included it into "The Moonlit Adeptus's Trail."

response.speaker: Baofei
response.text: Oh, no! Enough chitchat, I need to get back to work...

response.speaker: Baofei
response.text: If you'd like to try "The Moonlit Adeptus's Trail," just let me know. Everything's ready, we can start whenever you want.

choices.text: Are you planning to become a storyteller?
